1x TBE Buffer
experiments.purpose: Make 1x TBE buffer for TMSD native PAGE experiment.
experiments.materials:
- 2.033 g Magnesium Chloride Hexahydrate
- 900 mL Deionized Water
- 100 mL 10x TBE
- Weigh Boat
- Scale
- Scoopula
- 15 mL Conical Tube
- 500 mL Graduated Cylinder
- 1 L Bottle
experiments.procedure:
1. Made 1M MgCl₂:

    1. Weighed out 2.033 grams of magnesium chloride hexahydrate in a weighing boat.
    2. Added 10 mL of deionized water in the 15 mL conical tube.
    3. Transferred the magnesium chloride hexahydrate into the tube containing the deionized water, close, and shook well to dissolve.

2. In a 500 mL graduated cylinder, we measured out 890 mL of deionized water and transferred it into the 1 L bottle.

3. In the same graduated cylinder we measured out 100 mL of 10x TBE, then transferred into the same bottle containing the deionized water.

4. Added in 10 mL 1M MgCl₂ into the same bottle containing the water and 10x TBE.

5. Closed the bottle tightly and mixed thoroughly by inverting and shaking slightly.

6. Labelled the bottle and stored the buffer at room temperature in the cabinet.
experiments.notes:
- **2026/06/02:** We weighed out 2033.5 mg of magnesium chloride hexahydrate. When mixing the buffer appeared to be slightly cloudy, but started to settle after a minute.
- **2026/07/14:** We weighed out 2033.1 mg of magnesium chloride hexahydrate.
- **2026/07/15:** We weighed out 2032.9 mg of magnesium chloride hexahydrate.

experiments.title: PBS Buffer
experiments.purpose: Make 1x PBS buffer for TMSD native PAGE experiment.
experiments.materials:
- 200 mL 10x PBS
- 1600 mL Deionized Water
- 2.033 g Magnesium Chloride Hexahydrate (MgCl₂/6H₂O)
- 15 mL Conical Tube
- 2 L Glass Bottle
- pH Strip
experiments.procedure:
1. Measured 200 mL of 10x PBS solution and added it to a glass bottle.
2. Added 1600 mL of deionized water to the bottle.
3. Weighed out 2.033 g of magnesium chloride hexahydrate and added it into a 15 mL tube.

    1. Added 10 mL of deionized water to the tube and inverted to mix.
    2. Added the MgCl₂ salt to the glass bottle slowly, mixed well until the salt was completely dissolved.

4. Check the pH level using a pH strip.

5. Top off with deionized water to exactly 2 L.

6. Store at room temperature.

experiments.title: Non-SDS Native PAGE For TMSDX, TMSDY, TMSDS Strands
experiments.purpose: To prepare and run a native PAGE for the TMSD strands (no modifications) to ensure that the mechanism works appropriately in the PBS buffer.
experiments.partners: Sofea, Sukhman, Hannah, Anahat, Shahzaib, Neeor
experiments.materials:
- 1x PBS Buffer
- 6 mL 30% Acrylamide/Bisacrylamide (29:1)
- Deionized water
- 2.4 mL 5x TBE
- 200 uL 10% APS
- 1.2 uL SYBRSafe DNA Stain
- 10 uL TEMED
- TMSDX (invader strand)
- TMSDY (incumbent/aptamer module strand)
- TMSDS (substrate/anchor strand)
- 2 uL 6x DNA Loading Dye
- PAGE mini-gel assembly
- 2 glass plates
- Gel Comb
- Electrophoresis Power Supply
- 50 mL Conical Tube
- 15 mL Conical Tube
- 1.5 mL Eppendorf Tubes
experiments.procedure:
1. Prepared 1× PBS buffer using protocol 2.

2. Prepared the PAGE apparatus and checked for leakage.

    1. Cleaned glass plates and spacers using deionized water and ethanol.
    2. Dried thoroughly and assembled PAGE casting apparatus.
    3. Assembled one Hoeffer mini-gel (1 mm thickness).
    4. Added Milli-Q water between plates to check for leakage and leave for 20 minutes.
    5. If no leakage is observed then drain the water in the sink and use a kimwipes to dry the casting apparatus as much as possible making sure not to move the glass plates in the process.

3. Gel Preparation.

    1. Prepared 15% acrylamide gel solution according to Table 1 (for one gel) or Table 2 (for two gels).
    2. Prepared 5x TBE by adding 2 mL of deionized water and 2 mL 10x TBE in a 15 mL conical tube.
    3. Added 1.2 uL SYBRSafe for 12mL of gel preparation.
    4. Inverted the tube to mix thoroughly.
    5. Added 10 µL TEMED in the fume hood and quickly inverted the tube to mix.
    6. Quickly pipetted the gel into the casting apparatus using a P1000 pipette.
    7. Inserted the gel comb when done and make sure to wipe if it overflows.
    8. Let the gel polymerize for 30 minutes.

4. Gel Running Setup.

    1. Removed comb and placed gels into the electrophoresis tank.
    2. Filled the tank with 1× PBS buffer until gels and cathode and anode are fully submerged

5. TMSD Experiment Setup.

    1. Prepared samples according to the experiment being performed. **Incubated each sample of TMSDY and TMSDS for 30 minutes at 25°C BEFORE addition of TMSDX.** Do not incubate the samples with the DNA ladder.
    2. Prepare samples according to Table 3.
    3. Incubated all samples at 25 °C for 30 minutes.
    4. Added 2 µL of 6× DNA loading dye to each sample before loading and mix gently by pipetting up and down and tapping the tube on the table to get the samples to the bottom.

6. Loaded the samples into the wells, keep track of what samples go where.

    1. Pipetted 6 uL of the sample twice using P10 pipette.

7. Electrophoresis.

    1. Ran the gel at 120 V for ~40 minutes.
    2. Turned off the power supply and discarded the buffer.
    3. Performed post-run staining with SYBR Safe.

**Table 1.** PAGE% preparation for 12mL. [[DNA Polyacrylamide Gel Electrophoresis, n.d.](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Onuh-Peter/post/What_is_a_good_protocol_for_making_125_poly_acrylamide_gel_for_DNA/attachment/5b77f67ecfe4a7f7ca5b24da/AS%3A660926403444736%401534588542417/download/DNA_PAGE.pdf)]

- 10% gel: 4.0 mL 30% acrylamide/bisacrylamide (29:1), 5.4 mL H₂O (Milli-Q), 2.4 mL 5X TBE, 200 µL 10% APS
- 14% gel: 5.6 mL 30% acrylamide/bisacrylamide (29:1), 3.8 mL H₂O (Milli-Q), 2.4 mL 5X TBE, 200 µL 10% APS
- **15% gel: 6.0 mL 30% acrylamide/bisacrylamide (29:1), 3.4 mL H₂O (Milli-Q), 2.4 mL 5X TBE, 200 µL 10% APS**
- 16% gel: 6.4 mL 30% acrylamide/bisacrylamide (29:1), 3 mL H₂O (Milli-Q), 2.4 mL 5X TBE, 200 µL 10% APS

**Table 3.** TMSD Experiment

- Tube 1: TMSDY (10 µL). Single-strand control
- Tube 2: TMSDS (10 µL). Single-strand control
- Tube 3: TMSDX (10 µL). Single-strand control
- Tube 4: TMSDY + TMSDS (5, 5 µL). Pre-form S/Y: incubate 30 mins @ 25 degrees before loading
- Tube 5: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=0 (start point): Immediately load after TMSDX addition (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
- Tube 6: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=5: Wait 5 mins after TMSDX addition to load (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
- Tube 7: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=10: Wait 10 mins after TMSDX addition to load (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
- Tube 8: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=0 (start point): Immediately load after TMSDX addition (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
- Tube 9: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=5: Wait 5 mins after TMSDX addition to load (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
- Tube 10: TMSDY + TMSDS + TMSDX (3.33, 3.33, 3.33 µL). T=10: Wait 10 mins after TMSDX addition to load (after 30 min incubation of S/Y)
experiments.notes:
- **2026/06/08, 2026/07/14, 2026/07/16:** Run in 1x TBE buffer (7 tubes, Tubes 1-7 of Table 3). The 2026/07/20 run (procedure above) switched to 1x PBS buffer and added Tubes 8-10.
- **2026/06/08:** The first gel polymerized too quickly and did not allow proper gel casting, so we made a second gel. The first two wells were not used, they did not polymerize properly. We did not microcentrifuge the tubes because the timing was weird, so the senior lab member said that it was okay to pipette the samples up and down and tap the tube.
- **2026/07/14:** No bands visible before staining.
- **2026/07/16:** The shorter glass plate had a crack and broke off in the corner to the right of well 10.
- **2026/07/16:** The electrophoresis tank was fully submerged in the TBE buffer up to the “4 gel” label on the tank. This was to ensure that the cathode and anode maintained contact with the buffer to maintain a stronger current compared to past trails at about 0.4 A (better compared to 0 A to 0.01 A) and overall prevent any circuit break.
- **2026/07/16:** The electrophoresis power supply did present an error, “E01 - no load detected”, which interrupts the gels from running. This was resolved by resetting the supply to 120 V and ensuring a current was running again.
- **2026/07/20:** The gel was run for 40 minutes and the buffer in the inner chamber appeared to be cloudy.
- **2026/07/20:** The current was 0.6-0.8 A; PBS buffer appeared to conduct better/faster.
experiments.results:
- **2026/06/08 (Figures 1-2, 1x TBE):** No visible bands were detected before staining. Approximately three fluorescent green bands were observed after staining and imaging using the Bento Lab system. The observed bands appeared faint and lacked sharp resolution, limiting detailed analysis of migration patterns.
- **2026/07/14-15 (Figures 3-4, 1x TBE):** No visible fluorescent bands were observed under blue-light illumination, before or after staining.
- **2026/07/16 (Figure 5, 1x TBE):** Strong fluorescence bands observed for all lanes excluding 5 and 7.
- **2026/07/20 (Figure 6, 1x PBS):** Fluorescent bands observed for all lanes excluding 4, 6, 8, and 10.

    4. Inverted the tube to mix thoroughly.
    5. Added 10 µL TEMED in the fume hood and quickly inverted the tube to mix.
    6. Quickly pipetted the gel into the casting apparatus using a P1000 pipette.
    7. Inserted the gel comb when done and make sure to wipe if it overflows.
    8. Let the gel polymerize for 30 minutes.

4. Gel Running Setup.

    1. Removed comb and placed gels into the electrophoresis tank.
    2. Filled the tank with 1× PBS buffer until gels and cathode and anode are fully submerged

5. TMSD Experiment Setup.

    1. Prepared samples according to the experiment being performed. **Incubated each sample of TMSDY and TMSDS/Aptamer for 30 minutes at 25C BEFORE addition of TMSDX.** Do not incubate the samples with the DNA ladder.

    2. Incubated all samples at 25 °C for 30 minutes.

    3. Added 2 µL of 6× DNA loading dye to each sample before loading and mix gently by pipetting up and down and tapping the tube on the table to get the samples to the bottom.

6. Loaded the samples into the wells, keep track of what samples go where.

    1. Pipetted 6 uL of the sample twice using P10 pipette.

7. Electrophoresis.

    1. Ran the gel at 120 V for ~40 minutes.
    2. Turned off the power supply and discarded the buffer.
    3. Performed post-run staining with SYBR Safe.

experiments.title: Non-SDS Native PAGE Staining and Imaging Process
experiments.purpose: To stain the TMSD native PAGE gel and image the gel.
experiments.partners: Sukhman, Shahzaib, Sofea, Hannah, Anahat, Neeor
experiments.materials:
- 5 µl SYBRSafe DNA Stain
- 50 mL 1x TBE Buffer
- Gel From Non-SDS Native PAGE
- Plastic Tray
experiments.procedure:
1. Prepared the staining solution by adding 5 µL of SYBR Safe DNA stain to 50 mL of 1x TBE buffer in a plastic tray and mixing thoroughly.
2. Carefully transferred the native PAGE gel into the staining solution.
3. Covered the tray with aluminum foil to protect the stain from light exposure.
4. Manually and gently agitated the staining tray every few minutes  for 30 minutes during the staining process at room temperature.
5. Removed the gel from the staining solution and transferred it to the Bento Lab imaging system.
6. To capture an image, cover the side slits of the orange plastic cover of the Bento imaging system with masking tape and black sharpie to block out light. Then with the room lights dimmed, hover over gel to capture the image.
7. Captured fluorescence images of the stained gel.
8. Discarded stained gel.
experiments.notes:
- Prior to staining, imaging of the gel showed no visible bands.
- A rocking platform was not available, therefore manual agitation was performed periodically throughout the staining process.
- To image the gels using the Bento Lab imaging system, cover the side slits of the orange plastic cover that goes on top of the blue light with a few layers of masking tape and black sharpie. Then hover over the gel/orange cover to capture an image of the fluorescent bands.
- **2026/06/08, 2026/07/31 and undated runs:** Stained the gel for approximately 15 minutes at room temperature; the other runs stained for 30 minutes.
- **2026/07/15:** The gel was stored overnight in buffer in the fridge before staining; after imaging, the stained gel was stored in the fridge for 45 minutes and re-imaged. There were no bands present when imaging using the blue light. Staining the gel for longer does not help.
- **2026/07/20:** The staining solution was made with 50 mL of 1x PBS buffer instead of 1x TBE buffer.
experiments.results:
- SYBR Safe staining successfully enabled visualization of DNA-containing species in the native PAGE gel.
- No visible bands were detected before staining.
- **2026/06/08:** Approximately three fluorescent green bands were observed after staining and imaging using the Bento Lab system. The observed bands appeared faint and lacked sharp resolution, limiting detailed analysis of migration patterns.
- **2026/07/31 (Figure 12, control strands):** A strong fluorescent band was observed in lane 2 and a faint fluorescent band was observed in lane 4. Lane 1 contains the Thiol TMSDY strand. Lane 2 contains the AB42AptTS strand. Lane 3 contains the TMSDX strand. Lane 4 contains the TMSDS strand. Lane 5 contains the TMSDY strand.
- Results for each gel are listed under the matching native PAGE experiment.

experiments.title: Resuspending Oligonucleotides
experiments.purpose: To resuspend TMSD and aptamer strands from IDT in TE buffer and have a 100 um stock solution ready.
experiments.materials:
- Aptamer Strands
- TMSD Strands
- 1x TE Buffer pH 7.5 (Nuclease free)
experiments.procedure:
1. Poured 1x TE buffer from IDTE in a beaker.
2. To resuspend the oligonucleotides, checked the nmol (nanomoles) on the label and multiply the value by a factor of 10.

    1. For example, if TMSDX is listed 134 nmol on the tube, then multiply it by 10 to get 1340, which means 1340 uL (1.34 mL) of TE buffer should be added to the tube in order to get 100 uM stock solution.
3. Added 1340 uL of TE buffer to the TMSDX strands.
4. Added 983 uL of TE buffer to the TMSDY strands.
5. Added 56 uL of TE buffer to AB42AptTS strands.
6. Added 754 uL of TE buffer to the TMSDS strands.
7. Added 152 uL of TE buffer to the NSThiolTMSDY strands.
8. Added 306 uL of TE buffer to AB42Apt strands.
9. Added 338 uL of TE buffer to C6AB42AptTS strands.
10. Added 127 uL of TE buffer to the ThiolTMSDY strands.
11. Added 87 uL of TE buffer to the NSC6AB42AptTS strands.
12. Vortexed all the tubes for 30 seconds and stored them in the -20 freezer.
experiments.notes:
- The film was at the bottom of each tube.
- After vortexing/resuspending the film dissolved.

experiments.title: Diluting Oligonucleotides Stock Solution
experiments.purpose: To make a 10 um dilution of Thiol TMSDY and aptamer+Aβ4 from the 100 um stock solution and 1 um dilution from 10 um stock solution.
experiments.materials:
- 1x TE Buffer pH 7.5
- TMSD Solutions 100 um Stock
- Aptamer Solutions (C6AB42AptTS, AB42AptTS, AB42Apt) 100 um Stock
- Nuclease Free Water
- 1.5 mL Eppendorf Tube
experiments.procedure:
-  10 um solutions:

    1. Poured TE buffer from IDTE into a beaker.
    2. Pipetted 90 uL of the TE buffer into the eppendorf tube.
    3. Thawed thiol TMSDY 100 um solution from the -20°C freezer and vortexed.
    4. Pipetted 10 uL of the thiol TMSDY solution into the eppendorf tube containing the TE buffer.
    5. Vortexed the solution briefly and stored in the -20°C freezer.
    6. Repeat the procedure for all aptamers solutions, using nuclease free water

-  1 um solutions:

    7. Pipetted 90 uL of the TE buffer into the eppendorf tube.
    8. Pipetted 10 uL of the 10 um thiol TMSDY solution into the eppendorf tube containing the TE buffer.
    9. Vortexed the solution briefly and stored in the -20°C freezer.
    10. Repeat the procedure for all aptamers solutions, using nuclease free water
experiments.notes:
- **2026/07/21:** Made a 10 um dilution of Thiol TMSDY from the 100 um stock solution (90 uL TE buffer + 10 uL stock).
- **2026/07/22:** Made a 10 um dilution of non-specific thiol TMSDY from the 100 um stock solution (90 uL TE buffer + 10 uL stock).
- **2026/07/27:** Made 10 um and 1 um dilutions of thiol TMSDY and the aptamers (procedure above).
